lane: H73-1 piedmont micro-scarp chains (polarity x straight-chain collinearity x subsurface-step witness), fully unsupervised; no catalogue/SGMC training, no distance-to-catalogue feature, no scored raster input
hypothesis: Expert-added hidden faults are disproportionately low piedmont scarps in alluvium: one-sided 1 m-LiDAR steps that chain collinearly over >=1 km and coincide with a basement/gravity/magnetic step, in deep-basement, gentle-slope, low-relief terrain where catalogue mapping is incomplete.
non_fault_mimic: Pleistocene Lake Lahontan shoreline benches and fluvial terrace risers (contour-parallel piedmont steps with no subsurface step)
surface_formula_E1: S = sqrt(scarp_n * clip(1.4*chain,0,1)) * (0.55+0.45*substep) * (0.45+0.55*pied_soft); norm(x)=clip((x-p01)/(p99-p01),0,1) on footprint

components.chain: max over 16 azimuths of mean skeleton occupancy at offsets t=-6..6 (excluding 0), skeleton = scarp_n >= footprint P90 of scarp_n
components.substep: mean of top-2 of {norm(|grad gaussian(depth_to_base_surf,2)|), norm(iso_grav_anom_slope), norm(tmi_hg)}
components.pied_soft: (clip(depth/750,0,1) * clip(1-slope/20,0,1) * clip(1-relief5/120,0,1))^(1/3), relief5 = 5x5 max-min of det_elev

experiments.E2: E1 with piedmont factor replaced by 1.0 (tests the domain hypothesis)
experiments.E3: E1 with chain factor and subsurface factor replaced by 1.0 (piedmont scarp only)

emission_frozen.rule: score-ordered greedy selection, ties by flat index
emission_frozen.allowed: footprint AND Euclidean distance to visible catalogue > 2.0 px

controls: random_dots (seed 73, same allowed domain and budget)
primary_instrument.bootstrap: paired physical spatial-cluster percentile, 1000 draws, vendor pooled_summary

leakage_canary: every input/derived channel alone: symmetric AUC = max(AUC,1-AUC) must be <= 0.90 vs catalogue and vs pooled withheld truth
promotion_rule: selected experiment beats h33_analogue_foldfair pooled HOLDOUT-DTI with paired 95% CI excluding 0 AND canaries pass AND uniqueness passes; else verdict=negative and file labelled DO-NOT-SUBMIT
secondary_proxy_report_only_not_for_sele: DTI vs SGMC off-catalogue piedmont subset (truth never used by the method)
